prompt.en: Statues of Lady Justice wear a blindfold. What does the blindfold stand for?
prompt.fr: Les statues de la Justice portent un bandeau sur les yeux. Que représente ce bandeau?

options.en: Laws are applied fairly, looking only at the facts.
options.fr: Les lois sont appliquées de façon impartiale, en tenant compte des faits seulement.

options.en: Judges are not allowed to read the news.
options.fr: Les juges n'ont pas le droit de lire les nouvelles.

options.en: Court hearings are held in private.
options.fr: Les audiences des tribunaux se tiennent à huis clos.

options.en: The names of judges are kept secret.
options.fr: Les noms des juges demeurent secrets.

explanation.en: The blindfold is a sign that our laws are applied without favour. Only the facts of the case count.
explanation.fr: Le bandeau montre que nos lois sont appliquées sans favoritisme. Seuls les faits de la cause comptent.

source.quote: The blindfolded Lady Justice symbolizes the impartial manner in which our laws are administered: blind to all considerations but the facts

verification.evidence: Picture: Scales of Justice, Vancouver Law Courts. The blindfolded Lady Justice symbolizes the impartial manner in which our laws are administered: blind to all considerations but the facts
